title: Romans Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Romans 2: the man who judges others, God's judgment according to works, and what the chapter says about the law and circumcision.

questions.text: What does the chapter say happens to the person who judges another?
questions.explanation: It says that in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself, for you who judge practice the same things.

answers.text: He is praised for his knowledge of the law
He is excused because he knows the truth
He becomes a teacher of the foolish
He condemns himself, because he practices the same things

questions.text: What does the chapter say the goodness of God leads you to?
questions.explanation: It asks whether you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance.

answers.text: To wisdom
To repentance
To the law
To glory and honor

questions.text: According to the words quoted here, how will God pay back everyone?
questions.explanation: The text quotes that he "will pay back to everyone according to their works."

answers.text: According to their birth
According to their knowledge of the law
According to their works
According to the measure of their gifts

questions.text: What will those receive who seek glory, honor and incorruptibility by perseverance in well-doing?
questions.explanation: To those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor and incorruptibility, the text promises eternal life.

answers.text: Eternal life
A place among the prophets
A crown of gold
The land of their fathers

questions.text: What does the chapter say about God and partiality?
questions.explanation: Romans 2:11 says that there is no partiality with God.

answers.text: God shows favor to those under the law
There is no partiality with God
God judges the Greek before the Jew
God hears only the doers of the law

questions.text: Who are righteous before God, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: It says it is not the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified.

answers.text: The hearers of the law, not the doers
Those who teach the law to others
Those who are circumcised in the flesh
The doers of the law, not the hearers

questions.text: What does the chapter say Gentiles who do not have the law show?
questions.explanation: It says they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them.

answers.text: The work of the law written in their hearts
A law given to them by the prophets
The form of knowledge and of the truth
A covenant made with their fathers

questions.text: What is the man who bears the name of a Jew confident that he himself is?
questions.explanation: He is confident that he is a guide of the blind and a light to those who are in darkness.

answers.text: A prophet sent to the nations round about
A judge over the twelve tribes of Israel
A guide of the blind and a light to those in darkness
A priest serving in the temple at Jerusalem

questions.text: What does the chapter say happens to a man's circumcision if he is a transgressor of the law?
questions.explanation: It says circumcision profits if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

answers.text: It still profits him fully
It has become uncircumcision
It is counted as the work of the law
It makes him a teacher of babies

questions.text: Where does the praise of the one who is a Jew inwardly come from?
questions.explanation: It says that his praise is not from men, but from God, and that circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit not in the letter.

answers.text: From the elders of the synagogue
From the letter of the law
From his own conscience
From God, not from men
